disclosure.body: You are chatting with an automated assistant.

automated-assistant.body: This is an automated assistant, not a person. If you would like a person to reply, just ask.

fallback.body: Sorry, I could not answer that. If you would like a person to reply, tap the button below or ask for a person.

unsupported-type.body: Sorry, I can only read text messages. Please type your question. If you would like a person to reply, tap the button below or ask for a person.

handover-in-hours.body: A person will reply to you here.

handover-out-of-hours.body: We are closed right now. A person will reply after we open: {{opening}}. You can also reach us at {{contact}}.

emergency.body: If this is an emergency, please contact your local emergency services now. This assistant cannot help with emergencies.

opt-out-confirmation.body: You will get no more messages from us that you did not ask for. To get them again, tap the button below or send START.

opt-in-confirmation.body: You will get our messages again. To stop them, tap the button below or send STOP.

rate-notice.body: You have sent many messages in a short time, so the assistant will pause for a while. Please try again later.

opt-in-question.body: Would you like to get our messages again? Tap the button below or send START.
